question: Town U is to the north of Town V. Town W is to the east of Town U. Town X is to the south of Town W. Town Y is to the west of Town X. Town V is to the south-west of Town Y. What is the position of Town U with respect to Town Y?
solution:
**Given: **Town U is to the north of Town V. Town W is to the east of Town U. Town X is to the south of Town W. Town Y is to the west of Town X. Town V is to the south-west of Town Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e5fc428ba2c942f54d422a11edad5e529d87c4d232dd29d8fd0b757b5df3a76.png] 

Thus, Town U is to the North-west with respect to Town Y.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
